hearing_scheduling.summary: Coordinate with opposing party on time required, then email assistant with parties copied. File motion first and attach it to the request. Scheduling instructions say no online scheduling; await confirmation before noticing.

chambers_communications.summary: Email preferred; copy parties, put case name/number in subject and request in message body. Avoid duplicate inquiries. Prior approval required for faxes.

proposed_orders.summary: Email Word proposed orders with the underlying motion. Do not submit before hearing unless requested by the court.

courtesy_copies.summary: Email electronic hearing materials with pertinent portions highlighted, five business days before hearing; no paper binders.

remote_appearances.summary: Profile first states no remote appearances, but then describes court-ordered exceptions and JAC hearings. Requests require motion/approval; assistant supplies Zoom access if approved. Preserve the qualification rather than asserting a universal prohibition.
